entities.summary: Efe Obada is a British-Nigerian professional American football defensive end. He first played at an amateur level for the London Warriors of the BAFA National Leagues, later for the NFL's Dallas Cowboys, Kansas City Chiefs, Atlanta Falcons, Carolina Panthers, Buffalo Bills, and Washington Commanders.
